title: Does NEXP require superpolynomial constant-depth threshold circuits?
formal: Is NEXP not contained in nonuniform TC⁰, the class of languages with polynomial-size constant-depth Boolean circuits with majority gates?
context:
NEXP lower bounds against ACC⁰ do not establish this stronger separation.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: Tests whether the algorithmic approach to circuit lower bounds can cross the threshold-gate barrier.
